info.title: API-DocTest-List Support Tickets Reopens-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Reopen API provides the functionality to retrieve information about support tickets that are eligible for reopening. This endpoint allows users to obtain a list of previously closed tickets that can be reactivated due to ongoing issues. Typical consumers include customer support representatives and system administrators who manage ticketing processes. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure that customer concerns are addressed in a timely manner and facilitate seamless service continuity.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to reopen a previously closed ticket, enabling further actions or updates to be made by the support team.

requestBody.description: Request body for reopening a ticket, which requires specifics about the ticket to be processed. Ensure all necessary fields are filled accurately.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the ticket has been reopened.

audit.description: Contains audit information related to the operation.
